patch.$description: Paper-on-paper lift under a correction patch. Keep it faint — this is a slip of tape, not a UI card.

stamp-print.$description: Rubber-stamp ink opacity in the print pipeline.

stamp-web.$description: Rubber-stamp ink opacity in the web theme.

angle.$description: Rotations in degrees. Negative is counter-clockwise. Use as rotate(calc(var(--fx-angle-*) * 1deg)).

stamp-print.$description: Stamp tilt in the print pipeline.

stamp-web.$description: Stamp tilt in the web theme.

patch-print.$description: Correction-patch tilt in the print pipeline.

patch-web.$description: Correction-patch tilt in the web theme.

patch-gradient.$description: Direction of the correction-patch linear gradient (light -> mid -> dark).

offset.$description: Horizontal offset of the second strike that fakes bold. The web theme applies it as a text-shadow; the print pipeline doubles the glyphs in markup (diegetic-docs bin/typewriter.py), because WeasyPrint has neither faux bold nor text-shadow.

gradient-stop.$description: Stop positions (percent) of the correction-patch gradient, paired with patch.light / patch.mid / patch.dark.
